what_you_can_study: MSc Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, AI/ML, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering
english_availability: Many English programs, especially at TUs and research universities
typical_requirements: Bachelor in CS/IT or related; strong maths/CS credits; IELTS 6.5 typical
indian_background_fit: B.E./B.Tech CS/IT fits well; non-CS needs credits check
admission_difficulty: Medium to very high depending on university
german_language_need: German helps but English is common in tech jobs
job_outlook: Strong demand: developers, data/ML engineers, DevOps, security
top_cities: Munich, Berlin, Stuttgart, Frankfurt, Hamburg; study in Chemnitz, Saarbrucken, Dresden, Aachen
notes: Most popular course among Indian students; competition is high at top universities

what_you_can_study: MSc Management, Finance, Marketing, International Business, MBA
english_availability: English programs mostly at universities and private business schools
typical_requirements: Business/economics background preferred; GMAT/GRE and work experience often required; IELTS 6.5-7.0
indian_background_fit: BBA/B.Com/B.Tech + work experience; MBA needs 2+ years experience
admission_difficulty: High at top public universities; private schools easier but costly
german_language_need: German is a strong advantage for jobs
job_outlook: Consulting, finance, marketing, supply chain, product roles; fewer jobs than IT without German
notes: Private schools charge EUR 15,000-40,000+ for MBA; check ROI carefully

what_you_can_study: MSc Public Health, Molecular Medicine, Neuroscience, Biomedical Engineering, Healthcare Management; nursing vocational training (Ausbildung)
english_availability: English Masters exist in biomedical/public health; clinical medicine and nursing are mostly German-taught
typical_requirements: Relevant bachelor (life sciences, biotech, B.Pharm, BDS, B.Sc Nursing, engineering for biomedical); IELTS 6.5; German for clinical and nursing roles
indian_background_fit: MBBS holders cannot directly practise: need license recognition (Approbation), German B2/C1, medical language exam and possibly a knowledge exam; check state authority
admission_difficulty: High for biomedical research Masters; medicine degree itself is extremely competitive and German-taught
german_language_need: German is essential for clinical and nursing roles
job_outlook: Healthcare, pharma, biotech, medtech, public health; shortage of nurses and doctors but language and recognition required
top_cities: Berlin, Munich, Heidelberg, Goettingen, Tuebingen, Hamburg, Luebeck
notes: Be clear: MBBS-to-doctor path is a licensing path, not a Masters; many students choose biomedical/public-health Masters or nursing Ausbildung

what_you_can_study: MSc Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Mechatronics, Automotive, Aerospace, Renewable Energy
english_availability: Mixed: many engineering Masters need German; English tracks exist in selected programs
typical_requirements: B.E./B.Tech in the same field; strong core subjects; IELTS 6.5 or German B2/C1 for German-taught
indian_background_fit: Indian B.E./B.Tech fits well; check ECTS-equivalent credits
admission_difficulty: Medium to high; top TUs are very competitive
german_language_need: German is strongly needed for most industry jobs
job_outlook: Automotive, manufacturing, energy, aerospace, electronics; strong industry but German-language heavy
top_cities: Stuttgart, Munich, Aachen, Chemnitz, Dresden, Berlin, Hamburg
notes: Check language of instruction carefully; many students underestimate the German requirement
